episodes.title: The Road Not Taken
episodes.summary: The passengers wake up on board the Origin, abandoned in space. They search for other survivors, but find something else entirely.

episodes.title: Lost on Both Sides
episodes.summary: A tense showdown prompts a difficult decision. Shun and Lana realise that the threat could be nearer than any of them thought.

episodes.title: Bright Star
episodes.summary: A survivor's life hangs in the balance – and they hold the key. A new discovery threatens to tear the group apart.

episodes.title: God's Grandeur
episodes.summary: Weakness leads to danger, as our passengers truly begin to understand what they're up against. But who can they trust?

episodes.title: Remember Me
episodes.summary: An object from Earth threatens to blow SIREN's mission wide open, while suspicion boils over into full blown paranoia.

episodes.title: Fire and Ice
episodes.summary: An unexpected find prompts a life or death dilemma, while reminders of home lead to a brutal revelation.

episodes.title: The Wasteland
episodes.summary: The stakes are raised when the ship takes control, and our passengers are forced to attempt the impossible.

episodes.title: Funeral Blues
episodes.summary: Tension and paranoia abounds in the wake of a shocking discovery. Anyone could be a suspect.

episodes.title: A Total Stranger
episodes.summary: A surprise visitor threatens to plunge the ship into chaos. Drastic measures are taken, but death continues to haunt the Origin.

episodes.title: I Am
episodes.summary: A chilling revelation changes everything, while SIREN itself is called into question.
